verdict.rationale: Python is well covered by first-party docs: a modular official Python SDK with `auto_instrument=True` zero-config tracing and tracing decorators such as @tracer.chain and @tracer.tool. On the JS/TS side, the evidence only implies support: auto-instrumentation for JS frameworks (Mastra, Vercel AI SDK), an npm-distributed `@arizeai/phoenix-cli setup` command, and generic OTLP ingestion. None of these explicitly documents an official JS/TS instrumentation SDK. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official JS/TS tracing SDK, a JS/TS API reference comparable to Python's, and independent hands-on corroboration for either language.
